name: revdoku
description: Revdoku publishes your docs as a site from GitHub or uploaded files. Create buckets, edit and publish docs, read site analytics and answer support tickets through the hosted Revdoku MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Revdoku publishes your docs as a site from GitHub or uploaded files. AI agents read the site through its MCP server, visitors ask questions, and support requests arrive as tickets. Connect ChatGPT to create buckets, edit and publish docs, read site analytics and answer tickets. Revdoku scans incoming email for malware, labels prompt-injection attempts as Junk and keeps Junk content away from the assistant. You choose which accounts and buckets each connection can use, and every read and change is logged.
capabilities: Edit and publish the docs of a site
Read site analytics and what the docs miss
defaultPrompt: Publish the latest changes of my Revdoku docs site.
Show what visitors of my docs site could not find this week.
Reply to the latest question in the support tickets of my docs site.
